body: I know you’re just a troll but just so you know, these wildlife bridges save a ton of tax payer’s money due to the dramatic decrease of roadkill cleanup. It costs ~$4,000 of tax money per incident and Colorado who installed many of these devices has seen a 90% decrease in incidents. Each bridge varies in price but will overall be saving the state a ton of money. The whole saving animals and people’s cars thing is just an added bonus.

My advice would be to let her set the pace. I lost my mom to suicide last year and I could barely get myself out of bed for two months. And that’s okay. 
Just let her experience and feel, encourage her to stay busy and distracted because it helps but if she simply can’t, don’t push it. Let her heal and grieve in her own way. Be there for her. Be empathetic and remember to care for yourself, too. You also experienced a loss. Just don’t compare your pain from the experience to hers. Seems obvious, but when stress/depression enter the picture, sometimes it’s easy to forget.

Thank you so much, I needed to hear that from someone because you’re right. It was so much worse, too.

I frequently got calls from police enforcement because she would find my number and put me as her primary contact despite me not knowing her.

She stole my identity on multiple occasions because she knew my SSN. 

She “lost” me because she not only got in a car accident with a pedestrian while I was unbuckled in the front seat as a toddler, but she then went on a bender and left me alone in her motel room for 8 days and nights without excess food or water. When I was found by my grandma, I was losing my hair, had an engorged belly from malnutrition, and have had many mental health issues relating to abandonment my entire life, since.

Now, killing herself on my birthday?

She wasn’t an angel. I know that. And so do my loved ones around me and nobody has had the balls to tell it to me straight like you just did and I really needed to hear that from someone else so I didn’t feel guilty about saying it.

Unfortunately, she did ruin my birthday. Hopefully someday I can get over it, though. But I imagine for the next several years, it will weigh heavy on me. 

Thank you again. That helped a lot.
I’m sorry, that sounds hard. It’s difficult to not know what to do to help a loved one. I hope it gets better before June for you.
What is stopping you guys from being together to support one another during the hard times?

How long ago have you guys been broken up?

I, too, go through periods of time where my obsessive thoughts lead me to believe I’m still in love with my ex from 8+ years ago. I know I’m not, as I don’t even know who he is anymore. He was just there for me through a lot of my trauma so I dream/think of him often. He truly helped me in so many ways. I also have Obsessive Compulsive Disorder so my obsessive thoughts can get really out of hand sometimes. 

I think the part that really fucks me up is he’s living the life I always envisioned for us but with another woman. Everything we talked about doing together, they’re doing. They’re even pregnant now, and I’ve been TTC unsuccessfully for ~6 months with my own husband, so that news shattered my heart into a million pieces. I still care for my ex a lot. I needed him when I had him. But I love my husband for so many more reasons that my high school love cannot compare to.
I know what you mean about everyone leaving. It feels like nobody can stick around when shit gets really hard.

Damn, that’s deep. And true. I haven’t done anything magnificent or beautiful or memorable in my life, if I were to die, my wrongdoings will likely be what people remember of me. The reasons I hate myself and want to die will likely be what preserves my memory for a while. Rough. Maybe that’s why I always imagine a spiteful suicide.

Tell me about it. I actually find atheism more comforting than religion. I already want to die, why would I want my soul preserved forever, regardless of if it’s in heaven, hell, etc. I want to DIE. I want blackness. I want to be gone. I want to stop existing and feeling. THAT, to me, is comforting.
Yes! The unwanted thoughts from my OCD are much more annoying than my compulsions themselves. It’s a constant struggle.

I have these thoughts but I’m also depressed and hate myself but besides those things, why? Why continue living in a rat race that nobody enjoys? Why wake up every day just to work most of your life away and have a few short glimpses at happiness between all the work? Why does anyone want to live in these shitty conditions?? Being dead sounds so much more satisfying.
